content.user_title: Redesign PDFs Without Changing Critical Facts
content.value_statement: Important PDFs can become easier to read while still preserving exact source facts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through redesign and verification.
actual_capabilities: Guides PDF redesign around reader priority while preserving source meaning.
Locks IDs, dates, amounts, labels, names, and operational facts before layout changes.
Requires visual checks for barcodes, QR codes, seals, signatures, stamps, and logos.
Supports receipts, invoices, appointments, forms, tickets, resumes, and reports.
Includes an optional local helper that extracts text, page renders, and embedded images.
Provides QA rules for comparing original and redesigned PDF renders.
limitations: It depends on local PDF tools available in the agent environment.
OCR quality may limit accuracy for scanned or damaged source files.
It cannot verify barcode contents unless a decoder is available.
Generated helper artifacts may contain sensitive source document data.

use_cases.title: Clean Receipt Redesign
use_cases.description: Make receipts easier to scan while preserving receipt numbers, totals, dates, payment references, seals, and barcodes.

use_cases.title: Invoice QA Review
use_cases.description: Compare a redesigned invoice against the source for changed totals, dates, line items, labels, logos, and layout collisions.

use_cases.title: Appointment PDF Clarity
use_cases.description: Highlight date, time, location, applicant, reference number, required documents, and next action without changing source values.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign A Simple PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Use prettify-pdf to redesign this PDF for readability. Preserve all IDs, dates, names, amounts, labels, barcodes, QR codes, and seals exactly.

prompt_templates.title: Highlight Key Receipt Facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use prettify-pdf on this receipt. Put amount, receipt number, date, payee, transaction references, and barcode visibility first. Keep every source value exact.

prompt_templates.title: Audit A Redesigned Invoice
prompt_templates.prompt: Use prettify-pdf to QA this redesigned invoice against the original. Check totals, invoice number, dates, payment terms, line items, logo, barcode, and collisions.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Preservation Manifest
prompt_templates.prompt: Use prettify-pdf with local guardrails if available. Extract source evidence, build a preservation list, redesign conservatively, render the final PDF, and report verification limits.

output_examples.input: A payment receipt with dense tables, a barcode, a seal, receipt number, date, and total amount.
output_examples.output: A clearer receipt PDF with a top summary, exact original identifiers, preserved barcode and seal, readable fee table, and a short verification note.

output_examples.input: A redesigned invoice that may have changed totals or hidden the logo.
output: Mismatch review for totals, dates, invoice number, line items, and label meaning.
Visual QA notes for clipped text, missing logo, barcode visibility, and table alignment.

output_examples.input: An appointment confirmation with long instructions and a reference number.
output_examples.output: A print-safe PDF that highlights appointment time, location, applicant, required documents, exact reference number, and unchanged source instructions.

best_practices: Render the source PDF before redesigning and keep a preservation list.
Copy locked values exactly before adding friendly explanations.
Render the final PDF and compare it visually against the source.
anti_patterns: Do not recreate barcodes, QR codes, seals, stamps, signatures, or logos.
Do not relabel ambiguous adjacent text as a guessed relationship or role.
Do not deliver a visually nicer PDF that clips or changes critical facts.

faq.question: Does this skill require a hosted service?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed for local tools and does not require a hosted API.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The repository includes guidance for Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and compatible local agents.

faq.question: What documents fit this skill best?
faq.answer: It fits receipts, invoices, appointments, forms, tickets, resumes, statements, and reports with important source facts.

faq.question: Can it change wording for clarity?
faq.answer: It can add helpful context, but exact source values and label meaning must stay intact.

faq.question: Does it preserve barcodes and signatures?
faq.answer: The workflow requires preserving machine-readable and official assets as source images when possible.

faq.question: What should users watch for?
faq.answer: Users should protect private PDFs and remove generated helper artifacts after sensitive work.
